## Life Summary
Caroline Hosking was born on 6 May 1851 at New Cumnock, Ayrshire, Scotland. She emigrated to South Australia at an unknown date (likely as a child with her family, but her parents' names are not yet recorded in the vault).

She married Robert Dunlop Lawrie on 3 July 1879 at the Church of Christ, Alma, South Australia. They had nine children together and farmed at "Bleak Farm," Long Plains.

She died on 5 January 1920 at Long Plains, South Australia — just over two years after her husband Robert.
